name: 彩度分布
description: 分析します the 分布 of color 彩度 values. AI images often have different 彩度 profiles than natural photographs.
mechanism: Computes 彩度 for each pixel and 分析する the resulting 分布. AI images may show peaks at unusual 彩度 values.
parameters: Color space: HSV, Metric: 彩度 ヒストグラム statistics
useCase: Detecting unusual 彩度 profiles in AI生成の images

references.title: Farid, H. (2009). Image Forgery Detection. IEEE Signal Processing Magazine.
Van de Weijer, J. et al. (2007). Edge-based Color Descriptors. IEEE TIP.
Lukáš, J. et al. (2006). Digital Camera Identification from Sensor Pattern Noise. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Reveals unnatural color 彩度 パターン
• Camera sensors have characteristic 彩度 curves
• AI images often show atypical 彩度 分布s
• Fast ヒストグラム-based computation
• Complementary chrominance 分析
limitations:
• Post-processing (vibrance, 彩度) changes 分布
• Depends heavily on scene content and lighting
• Monochrome or low-彩度 images are uninformative
• Camera ホワイトバランス affects 彩度 パターン
• AI models improving at realistic 彩度
